instruction.text: Can the relative pronoun be left out of this sentence?

instruction.text: Choose the most suitable relative clause to complete the sentence.

atoms.a: ssml: Thomas<break time='500ms'/> does athletics for the school team.
atoms.b: Thomas, ((++who_is_very_sporty which_is_nice that_is_sunny)), does athletics for the school team.

atoms.a: ssml: The park<break time='500ms'/> is where Pete meets his friends.
atoms.b: The park, ((++which_is_near_my_house whose_cat_is_mean that_is_naughty)), is where Pete meets his friends.

instruction.text: Choose the sentence where the relative clause is in the correct place.

b: ++Last weekend, we went to the countryside, which is my favourite place.
Last weekend, which is my favourite place, we went to the countryside.
++Paul, who is seven foot tall, enjoys playing basketball.
Paul enjoys playing basketball, who is seven foot tall.

instruction.text: Decide if the relative clause is referring to the noun or the whole sentence.

atoms.a: I missed my swimming lesson yesterday, <u>which was frustrating</u>.
Ollie has a hamster, <u>which is so cute</u>.

instruction.text: Choose the correct relative clause that refers to the whole sentence.

atoms.a: We went on holiday to Portugal...
atoms.b: We went on holiday to Portugal, ((++which_was_great which_is_a_nice_country)).
The bus was completely full, ((++which_made_Sam_late which_was_red)).

atoms.a: At the birthday party, we all ate the cake that Jack’s mum made.

instruction.text: Combine the two sentences together as one sentence, with a relative clause in the middle.

atoms.a: Tracey has invited me for a sleepover. She has a dog.
